title: What It Actually Takes to Deploy GenAI Applications to Enterprises: Arjun Bansal and Trey Doig

primary.label: AI Platforms & Developer Tooling
primary.rationale: The talk's core technical content centers on LLM-as-judge biases, AutoFeedback evaluation model building approaches, and quantitative evaluation accuracy improvements. Echo AI serves customer support conversation intelligence while Log10 provides a developer platform for measuring and improving LLM accuracy. The discussion spans production deployment of GenAI applications and the evaluation methodology used to ensure and maintain accuracy. Prerequisites include familiarity with LLM applications and enterprise customer support workflows. Recorded conference presentation at AI Engineer World's Fair with live product demos. Multiple quantitative results including 45% evaluation accuracy improvement and a published 20 F1 point case study support the claims.

summary:
Trey Doig presents Echo AI, a GenAI-native conversation intelligence platform serving billion-dollar retail brands. Using an iceberg metaphor, he explains that enterprises only see surface-level signals while vast insights remain locked beneath. Companies evolve through manual sampling, script-based analysis, and purpose-built software—all reactive. Generative AI enables 100% coverage, surfacing unknown issues like a manufacturing defect discovered in real time for Wine Enthusiasts. Echo AI's pipeline ingests conversations from contact systems, normalizes and compresses them, then runs them through dozens of configurable LLM pipelines where customers write and manage their own prompts. Accuracy is the central enterprise concern; Echo AI targets 95% accuracy and builds trust within seven days.

Arjun Bansal introduces Log10.io as an infrastructure layer for measuring and improving LLM accuracy, with a long-term vision of self-improving systems. He cites failure cases like Air Canada's chatbot and a Chevy dealership to motivate the accuracy challenge. Human review is the gold standard but slow and expensive; LLM-as-judge alternatives suffer from self-preference, positional bias, verbosity bias, and token diversity bias. Log10's AutoFeedback system combines human-level accuracy with model-based speed and cost advantages.

Arjun describes three approaches to building AutoFeedback models: few-shot learning, fine-tuning, and bootstrap synthetic data combined with fine-tuning. On the TLDR dataset, these approaches achieved a 45% improvement in evaluation accuracy by moving to annotator-specific models, upgrading base models, and using bootstrap synthetic data. The approach was sample-efficient, matching the accuracy of 1,000 ground truth examples with just 50. Log10 also matched GPT-4 accuracy using open-source models like MRL 7B and Llama 70B chat. The Log10 platform includes logging, debugging, evaluation, and auto-tuning features with seamless integration into common LLM SDKs and frameworks.

Trey demos Echo AI's integration with Log10, showing how auto-feedback criteria evaluate summarization quality against user-defined standards, how solution engineers can override feedback, and how the system tracks hallucinations and model drift in a data-driven way. Echo AI self-hosts models and trains domain-specific models due to high throughput needs. A case study demonstrated a 20 F1 point improvement in accuracy using AutoFeedback. Log10 offers an SDK, GitHub recipes, and notebooks for getting started.
whyItMatters: The talk connects its engineering abstractions, implementation choices, and AI/product implications into one practical system view.

sections.title: Echo AI: The Customer Conversation Intelligence Problem
sections.summary: Trey Doig introduces Echo AI using an iceberg metaphor for customer interactions. Enterprises evolve through manual sampling, script-based retroactive analysis, and purpose-built software—all reactive approaches. Generative AI enables 100% coverage to surface unknown issues.

sections.title: Echo AI: How It Works and Accuracy Focus
sections.summary: Echo AI gathers conversations from contact and ticket systems, normalizes and compresses them, and runs them through dozens of configurable LLM pipelines where customers write and manage their own prompts. Accuracy is the top enterprise concern, targeting 95% with seven-day trust-building. Wine Enthusiasts case study demonstrates real-time manufacturing defect detection.

sections.title: Log10.io: LLM Accuracy Challenges and Existing Approaches
sections.summary: Arjun Bansal introduces Log10 as an infrastructure layer for LLM accuracy with a vision of self-improving systems. He cites failure cases (Air Canada, Chevy dealership) and explains limitations of human review (slow, expensive) and LLM-as-judge (biased with self-preference, positional bias, verbosity bias, token diversity bias).

sections.title: Log10 AutoFeedback System and Downstream Uses
sections.summary: Log10's AutoFeedback system aims to combine human review accuracy with model-based speed and cost. It enables monitoring, triaging limited human resources, and curating high-quality datasets for automated prompt improvement and fine-tuning. Arjun begins describing three approaches to building AutoFeedback models.

sections.title: AutoFeedback Model Approaches, Results, and Platform Overview
sections.summary: Arjun details three approaches to building AutoFeedback models: few-shot learning, fine-tuning, and bootstrap synthetic data combined with fine-tuning. On the TLDR dataset, these achieved 45% improvement in evaluation accuracy via annotator-specific models, base model upgrades, and bootstrap data. The approach was sample-efficient, matching 1,000 ground truth examples with just 50. Log10 also matched GPT-4 accuracy with open-source models (MRL 7B, Llama 70B chat). The platform includes logging, debugging, evaluation, auto-tuning, and integrates with common LLM SDKs and frameworks.

sections.title: Echo AI Demo: Log10 Integration for Accuracy and Drift Tracking
sections.summary: Trey demos Echo AI showing a broken-TV phone conversation with summarization auto-graded by Log10 against user-defined criteria. Solution engineers can override feedback scores for collecting high-fidelity human feedback. A failed summarization example (reiterating instructions like a system prompt) is graded accordingly. Echo AI self-hosts models and trains domain-specific models for high throughput. Log10 enables tracking hallucinations and model drift in a data-driven way, replacing manual sampling.

sections.title: Case Study Results and Getting Started with Log10
sections.summary: Arjun highlights a 20 F1 point improvement in accuracy using AutoFeedback with Echo AI, published in a case study. Log10 provides a summarization app example, SDK with Python and other languages, GitHub recipes, and notebooks. Advanced models are available for free for a limited time.
